content.text: {"concept_key":"c5-maths-multiplication-zero-property","title":"Multiplying by Zero","quick":"Anything multiplied by 0 is always 0. Do the multiplication first, then add the remaining number.","full":"In a kirana shop, if you have 25 empty baskets and put 0 apples in each basket, you still have 0 apples total, no matter how many baskets there are. That is the zero property: any number times 0 gives 0. So in 25 × 0 + 75, first solve the multiplication part: 25 × 0 = 0. Then add 75 to it: 0 + 75 = 75. The rule for order is to always do multiplication before addition, like BODMAS teaches.","tip":"Zero times anything is still zero, like empty baskets with no apples.","answer":"75","traps":["Adding 25 and 75 first instead of multiplying 25×0 first","Thinking 25×0 gives 25 because they forget zero property","Making silly addition mistake after getting 0 correctly"],"misconception":"Child thinks multiplying by zero keeps the original number the same, like multiplying by 1.","parent_questions":[{"q":"What is 25 times 0?","expected_answer_hint":"Child should say 0, since anything times 0 is 0."},{"q":"Which do we solve first, multiplication or addition, in this sum?","expected_answer_hint":"Multiplication first, then addition, as per BODMAS rule."}],"check_question":{"q":"12 × 0 + 40 = ____","options":["40","12","52"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Correct! 12×0 is 0, then 0+40 is 40.","wrong_feedback":"Remember, 12×0 is 0 first, then add 40 to get 40."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A kirana shop owner holding several empty baskets with no apples inside, next to a separate basket full of apples.","labels":[{"text":"zero","position":"left"},{"text":"total","position":"right"}]}}
